items.question: What drove AMD's revenue change in FY2022?
items.answer: AMD’s FY2022 revenue increased 44%, to $23.6 billion from $16.4 billion [5]. Growth was driven by Data Center revenue rising 64% on higher EPYC processor sales, Gaming revenue rising 21% on higher semi-custom sales, and increased Embedded revenue from Xilinx product sales [3][5]. This was partly offset by a 10% decline in Client revenue, reflecting lower processor shipments amid a weak PC market and supply-chain inventory corrections [3][5].
